profile.name: Oleksii Voloshchuk
profile.bio: Experienced Game Developer, I specialize in building high-performance, cross-platform games with a focus on mobile and multiplayer experiences. My core strengths lie in Unity and C#, where I leverage my deep understanding of software design patterns, SOLID principles, and data structures to create clean, scalable, and maintainable code. I am passionate about crafting engaging and technically sound gaming experiences.

showcaseProject.title: 3D Life Simulation Game
showcaseProject.description: Worked as a key developer on this major 3D life simulation title. I was responsible for architecting core game systems, optimizing performance, and implementing various gameplay features to ensure a high-quality user experience and product growth.

achievements.description: High user rating on major platforms

featured.title: Featured Projects
featured.ndaNote: Note: Some commercial projects are not displayed or have been generalized due to non-disclosure agreements (NDA).

projects.title: Guardian Legacy
projects.description: A fast-paced 2D roguelike platformer characterized by its incredibly fluid spline-based animations and vibrant visual effects.

projects.title: Fall Survivor
projects.description: A survival game with classic mechanics like inventory management and building, but with a complex control system that allows the player to both control their fall and walk. Features unique manual crafting mechanics.

projects.title: ASCII Shader
projects.description: Inspired by Acerola's video on ASCII art rendering, this shader project recreates a unique visual style using ASCII characters. It translates the game's visuals into a nostalgic and technically interesting aesthetic.

hypercasual.title: Hypercasual Games
hypercasual.description: A selection of hypercasual games developed for various clients and publishers. This work involved rapid prototyping, designing engaging core loops, and preparing projects for market testing and publishing.

projects.title: RoboBobo
projects.description: Created in 4 days for GMTK 2024. A 2D platformer where players resize their character and objects to solve puzzles. Features FMOD integration and a post-jam multiplayer demo.

projects.title: Souls Binary Abyss
projects.description: Made in 6 days for Brackeys Jam #10. Features 2 enemy types and 3 playable characters, all made from scratch with a 3D modeller.

projects.title: Jija Escape
projects.description: Made in 1 week. Play as an office fish building your way up with spawning objects. Features a building system with snapping and p2p multiplayer via Mirror.

projects.title: 🌸 DAFFY 🌸
projects.description: A simple game inspired by Doom and Animal Crossing. Water flowers and shoot demons. Made in 48 hours with a 2D artist.

projects.title: Wave function collapse
projects.description: My implementation of the popular algorithm for generating simple landscapes from a given tilemap.

projects.title: Post office game prototype
projects.description: Developed a prototype of a post office simulator in one week with a 3D artist.

projects.title: RoboBobo Multiplayer
projects.description: A multiplayer version of the GMTK 2024 game, using Netcode for GameObjects and Unity Relay services.

projects.title: Meals and monsters
projects.description: Yet another gamejam project with gesture recongnition.

projects.title: Jija Escape
projects.description: You are an ordinary office fish that came to work. And suddenly on the very first day in the office, something terrible happens, and now you have to save your life by building upwards the Tower of Trash that gets in your way and avoiding the Muddy Slime Monster.
